SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-09-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUL-14-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF HAN LEE IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT IS LEITHER MOISE PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT PRIOR TO COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $3000.00 TO THE PLAINTIFF (INCLUDES COSTS) IN 2 PAYMENTS. THE FIRST PAYMENT OF $1500 IS TO BE DONE ON JUNE 15TH AND THE SECOND PAYMENT ON JUNE 30TH. PAYMENTS ARE TO BE MADE VIA APPLE PAY. THE RECORDING THE PLAINTIFF TOOK OF THE DEFENDANT'S SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IS TO BE DELETED AFTER THE RECEIPT OF THE LAST PAYMENT. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE JULY 14TH HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE, OR THE AGREEMENT IS BROKEN. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

DISMISSAL WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT. PLAINTIFF HAN LEE IS PRESENT. NO OTHER APPERANCES ARE MADE. PLAINTIFF REPRESENT TO THE COURT THAT THE TERMS OF THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT HAS BEEN MET AND THAT PAYMENT HAS BEEN RECIEVED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
